newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama free trade zone suspends exports to Ecuador.
newsitem.headline: Panama free trade zone suspends exports to Ecuador.

text.p: Panama's free trade zone in the Altlantic port of Colon suspended Friday exports to Ecuador due to that country's current political crisis, a leading trade zone official said.
Victoria Figge, manager of the Colon free trade zone, told reporters that the area's businesses had halted exports to Ecuador for "prudence".
Figge said Ecuador is the trade zone's second most important market with exports of more than $300 million per year.

Former Ecuadoran President Abdala Bucaram, ousted last week by congress during a 48-hour strike against his government, visited Panama earlier this week and has said he could use the Central American nation as a base to launch a bid to recapture power.
